The Talent Acquisition Manager will report to the Director of People & Culture and will be instrumental in the successful pre-opening and ongoing staffing of the resort. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage full-cycle recruitment for all operational and leadership positions across the resort. Develop and execute talent acquisition strategies aligned with pre-opening timelines and workforce plans. Partner with department heads to understand hiring needs and deliver timely, quality hires. Oversee candidate sourcing, screening, interviews, assessments, and offer management. Ensure compliance with local labor laws, visa processes, and Four Seasons recruitment standards. Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job boards, and external partners. Maintain accurate recruitment records, reports, and hiring metrics. Strong knowledge of recruitment systems, sourcing techniques, and interview methodologies. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills. bdaff5421404b55c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة الخليج للموارد البشرية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيساهم المهندس المدني في الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية وضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الجوانب الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية للمواقع الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى تحليل نتائج اختبارات فحص التربة. مراجعة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره المختلفة. إعداد تصاميم المشروع، ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات الفنية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع لضمان مطابقته للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المخططات الهندسية والتقارير الفنية. مهارات قوية في الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على الجودة والالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة صفوة الخليج للموارد البشرية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

bd323304a26b6725.description: Role Summary We are seeking a Resident Cybersecurity Engineer to work on-site with the customer’s Cybersecurity team. The engineer will provide day-to-day technical support, maintain and improve the deployed solutions, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with implementation partners and vendors when specialist support is needed. The role requires hands-on experience with One Identity IAM, Safeguard PAM, Defender MFA, and miniOrange SSO, along with a strong understanding of Data Classification System (DCS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and other enterprise cybersecurity solutions. Key Responsibilities Work closely with the customer’s Cybersecurity team to manage daily operations, incidents, service requests, and planned changes. Administer and troubleshoot One Identity IAM, Safeguard PAM, Defender MFA, and miniOrange SSO. Monitor integrations with Active Directory, applications, servers, network devices, and VPN platforms; investigate authentication and access issues. Support user provisioning, privileged access, MFA policies, SSO integrations, and access reviews. Support DCS and DLP operations, including policy monitoring, incident investigation, reporting, and coordination of policy changes. Perform health checks, review logs and alerts, and recommend corrective actions. Coordinate with product vendors and implementation partners to resolve complex issues and track them through closure. Maintain configuration records, operational procedures, incident reports, and knowledge transfer documentation. Support testing, upgrades, disaster recovery exercises, and the onboarding of additional applications or systems. Provide regular status updates and highlight risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities to the customer’s Cybersecurity team. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of experience implementing or supporting enterprise cybersecurity solutions. Hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with One Identity IAM, Safeguard PAM, and Defender MFA . Hands-on experience with miniOrange SSO and enterprise application integrations. Good working knowledge of DCS and DLP architecture, policies, incidents, and operational support. Strong understanding of Active Directory, LDAP, Windows and Linux, networking, certificates, and authentication protocols such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect. Experience working directly with customer technical and cybersecurity teams. Clear communication, documentation, and issue management skills. Preferred Experience Fortra DCS/DLP, Aruba ClearPass NAC, Oracle Audit Vault and Database Firewall, or similar solutions. High availability, disaster recovery, and change management in enterprise environments. Relevant product or cybersecurity certifications.

bd0c59ba9ce093ac.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اضافات العالمية للتجارة عن مدير سلسلة توريد للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة سلسلة التوريد داخل المنشأة، مع الإشراف على حركة البضائع والمواد من الموردين إلى المستهلكين. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان تحقيق الأداء الأمثل ورضا العملاء في جميع جوانب سلسلة التوريد. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع استراتيجيات الشركة وسياساتها وخططها العامة المتعلقة بسلاسل التوريد، ومباشرة تنفيذها. إدارة أنشطة سلسلة التوريد وتوجيهها، ومباشرة إجراءات سلسلة التوريد للبضائع والمواد. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة مستوى أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. مراقبة أداء العمليات والموظفين مقارنة بالأهداف المحددة، وتحديد الأنماط، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. وضع السياسات والإجراءات لضمان الالتزام بالقواعد واللوائح ذات الصلة، ومباشرة تنفيذها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إدارة سلسلة التوريد أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التخطيط الاستراتيجي والتنفيذ الفعال لعمليات سلسلة التوريد. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية لإدارة الفرق وتحفيزها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بتحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية والاستراتيجية للشركة في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير الموظفين وتحقيق أهدافهم المهنية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

bdefb9b7cdfcf250.description: About the Role UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company is seeking a Cost Control Officer to join their team. This full-time position is responsible for monitoring and managing project expenditures, ensuring adherence to budgets, and identifying opportunities for cost savings. The role involves analyzing financial data, tracking expenses, and implementing strategies to optimize project profitability while maintaining quality standards. The Cost Control Officer will also provide financial insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making and mitigate financial risks. Key Responsibilities Monitor project budgets and expenditures to ensure adherence to financial plans and identify any variances or discrepancies. Track and analyze project expenses, including labor costs, material purchases, subcontractor fees, and overhead expenses, to maintain accurate financial records. Conduct cost analysis and cost-benefit evaluations to identify cost-saving opportunities, optimize resource allocation, and improve project profitability. Prepare financial forecasts and projections based on project timelines, resource requirements, and market trends to support long-term planning and decision-making. Perform variance analysis to compare actual costs against budgeted costs, investigating any deviations and implementing corrective actions as needed to mitigate financial risks. Generate regular reports and financial statements summarizing project costs, expenses, and budget performance for management review and decision-making purposes. Develop and implement cost control procedures, policies, and best practices to enhance efficiency, streamline processes, and minimize wastage. Assist in contract negotiations, review contract terms and conditions, and ensure compliance with contractual agreements to mitigate financial risks and optimize cost-effectiveness. Collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and subcontractors to negotiate pricing, terms, and payment schedules, ensuring cost competitiveness and adherence to budgetary constraints. Provide financial advice and recommendations to project managers and stakeholders on cost-related matters, including budget planning, forecasting, and risk assessment, to support informed decision-making and project success. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Work Type This is a full-time position.

bd8fa2a43dd0c8d9.description: About Honeywell Honeywell is a global company focused on innovation across various sectors, including aerospace, building technologies, and performance materials. The company's work contributes to advancements in areas such as aviation, sustainable energy solutions, smart infrastructure, and space exploration. Role Overview Honeywell (KSA) is seeking an Advanced Project Engineer to join its team in Dhahran. This full-time role involves managing the engineering scope for telecommunications and security packages, from initial requirements analysis through to project execution and handover. The position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Partner with Sales and business stakeholders to identify, qualify, and develop the TSI opportunity pipeline. Provide technical consultancy and define solution strategies. Prepare and review proposals, estimates, and technical submissions. Support customer engagements through contract award and project execution. Manage the end-to-end engineering scope for telecommunications and security packages. Conduct requirements analysis, solution architecture, and detailed design. Oversee equipment selection, procurement support, and configuration. Manage Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), installation supervision, and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). Provide training, support start-up, commissioning, and final technical handover. Ensure engineering deliverables meet contractual obligations, quality expectations, applicable codes and standards, cybersecurity requirements, schedule commitments, and cost targets. Proactively manage technical risks, interfaces, changes, and escalations. Internal and External Relationships The Advanced Project Engineer will collaborate with various internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project success. Internal: Sales, Engineering Excellence Organization & Discipline Communities, Project Lead or Principal and Project Team, GES, COE or other Back-office locations (project team). External: Customers. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of relevant experience in project engineering. Demonstrated ability to manage end-to-end engineering scopes for telecommunications and security packages. Experience with requirements analysis, solution architecture, and detailed design. Proficiency in ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, quality standards, and cybersecurity requirements. Work Environment and Travel This role is responsible for the technical scope of assigned special designs and functions. Site travel may be required for up to 20% of the time.

bd496ad37b36457f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الزامل للإنشاءات الحديدية عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة، حيث يتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الهندسية الكهربائية لدعم مشاريع الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة تنفيذها. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركة المصنعة والتعليمات المعمول بها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الزامل للإنشاءات الحديدية في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للمهندسين الجدد تطوير مهاراتهم والمساهمة في مشاريع الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة الزامل للإنشاءات الحديدية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر قنوات التوظيف المتاحة.

bd1a84450fadae11.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 The Expansion Executive is responsible for managing expansion sales requests from existing customers while driving upselling and cross-selling opportunities. This role ensures that expansion deals are efficiently processed while maximizing revenue through additional product sales. Since expansion revenue is typically self-driven by customer requests, the executive focuses on enhancing deal value by strategically including upsell and cross-sell products. What Will You Do❓ Expansion Sales Management: Handle incoming new branch sales requests from existing customers. Generate and send quotes promptly, ensuring accuracy and alignment with customer needs. Track expansion requests and ensure timely follow-ups to close deals efficiently. Upselling & Cross-Selling Focus: Identifying new upselling & cross-selling opportunities from existing customers through outbound activities. Identify and recommend additional products to maximize revenue from expansion deals. Ensure that every expansion quote includes relevant upsell/cross-sell products before sending to the customer. Sales Process & Coordination: Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth processing of expansion sales. Communicate effectively with customers regarding their expansion needs and available solutions. Maintain accurate records of expansion requests in the CRM system. What Are We Looking For❓ 2+ years in sales, account management, or a related field. Experience in handling sales requests and generating quotes. Experience working with CRM systems to manage and track sales activities. Strong sales mindset with a focus on upselling and cross-selling. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities. Ability to work efficiently under pressure and meet deadlines. Experience in SaaS or technology sales is a plus. Knowledge of Foodics products and their value to different business models is a plus. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

bd62fd65da897795.description: We are looking for an E-Commerce & Marketplace Operations Executive to manage the day-to-day operations of our e-commerce store and marketplaces, including Zid, Amazon, Trendyol, and other sales channels . The role will be responsible for the full order lifecycle — from receiving and processing orders to fulfillment, shipping, delivery, inventory coordination, and resolving operational issues. The ideal candidate should be highly organized, hands-on, and capable of coordinating effectively between the warehouse, branches, customer service, marketplaces, and logistics partners. Key Responsibilities E-Commerce & Order Fulfillment Manage and monitor daily orders through the Zid Dashboard . Review and process incoming orders and ensure they are ready for fulfillment. Manage the complete order lifecycle from order receipt to picking, packing, shipping, and delivery. Coordinate Picking, Packing & Order Fulfillment with the warehouse team. Monitor pending and delayed orders and take immediate action to resolve issues. Handle operational issues related to missing items, incorrect orders, cancellations, exchanges, and returns. Ensure orders are processed and shipped within the required turnaround time. Marketplace Operations Manage daily operations across Amazon, Trendyol, and other marketplaces . Process and monitor marketplace orders according to each platform’s requirements and SLA. Ensure order and shipment statuses are updated accurately. Monitor marketplace cancellations, returns, delayed orders, and fulfillment issues. Coordinate inventory availability across the website and marketplaces. Identify and resolve operational issues that may negatively impact marketplace performance. Coordinate issues related to SKUs, barcodes, product mapping, and inventory synchronization . Inventory & Branch Coordination Monitor inventory availability across the e-commerce store and marketplaces. Coordinate with the warehouse and branches to ensure stock availability. Manage and follow up on stock transfers and replenishment between the warehouse and branches . Monitor low-stock and out-of-stock items and escalate when replenishment is required. Identify and resolve discrepancies between physical and system inventory. Ensure accurate SKU and barcode mapping across all sales channels. Shipping & Logistics Operations Manage daily operational coordination with courier and logistics partners. Ensure orders are assigned to the appropriate shipping provider. Monitor AWB creation, shipment pickup, delivery, and shipment status . Follow up on delayed, failed, or returned shipments. Coordinate with couriers, warehouse, and customer service teams to resolve delivery issues. Monitor recurring shipping problems and escalate them when required. Operations Control & Reporting Ensure accurate and timely order status updates across all systems and marketplaces. Conduct daily follow-ups on pending, delayed, and exception orders. Coordinate between E-Commerce, Marketplaces, Warehouse, Branches, Customer Service, and Logistics . Prepare operational reports covering order fulfillment, delays, cancellations, returns, and operational errors. Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective actions. Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to increase efficiency and reduce manual work. Requirements 2–4 years of experience in E-Commerce Operations, Marketplace Operations, Order Fulfillment, or a similar role. Hands-on experience in order processing, inventory management, fulfillment, and logistics operations. Experience with Zid is highly preferred. Experience with Amazon Seller Central and other marketplaces is preferred. Good understanding of Order Fulfillment, Inventory Management, and Marketplace Operations . Familiarity with SKU management, barcodes, inventory synchronization, and stock transfers . Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets . Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage a high volume of orders and coordinate across multiple teams. Strong attention to detail and ability to take ownership of daily operations. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Fulfillment Rate Order Accuracy Marketplace SLA Compliance Pending & Delayed Orders Order Cancellation Rate Inventory Accuracy Stock Availability Return & Failed Delivery Rate Issue Resolution Time Overall Operational Efficiency
